name: app.claspt/claspt
description: Memory and encrypted credentials for AI agents from the user's own Claspt vault: per-project memory with review, secrets by reference with approval, browser log-in, all local.

environment_variables.name: CLASPT_API_TOKEN
environment_variables.description: A token from Settings > Integrations or `claspt tokens create`

environment_variables.name: CLASPT_API_PORT
environment_variables.description: The desktop app's local API port (default 9315)
